craft_evidence.reasoning: The US site gives 'Imported' on every product page read and names no country, maker, mill or production site; the sustainability page points to Prada Group policy documents rather than Miu Miu's own making. Any Prada Group factory evidence would have to come from group filings, which this read did not open.
